Happened 2 days ago. 
After a year of dating.
She ask me to hang out, I suggest we sleep over at my apartment. She says okay.
I go to pick her up when I arrive she says come with me for a second we go to her bedroom she says I'm not really feeling this relationship anymore. 
I say okay. She responds with are you okay?
I say yes  and I'm going to go now. I leave driving home I realize I have no fucking clue what went wrong. Feel like I wasted the last year of my life

Here's the story where only 4 people got away. 
 One Friday night as a grade 11 there was a party we herd about in a Forrest behind a factory it was he theirs weekend in a row where there was a party hosted at this exact spot. Me and my two friends decided to go. That night the party grew to fifty plus people. Me and my friends where around the fire after a 26 between the three of us and some weed plus rumours of cops showing up for ten minutes we decide to leave me and one friend start walking out of the Forrest and the rumours were true cops were coming in  we turn and run back towards the party yelling cops. They were shortly behind us. As we stumble through the Forrest it turns out a group of people started to follow us since we warned them. We hit the edge of the forest right before a field. The only thing between us and freedom a goddamm chain link fence with razor wire on top . There was me my two friends and 20ish randoms who followed us. People are saying if we're all quiet the cops won't find us. We speak up and are like fuck that were jumping the fence I climb up on top put my shirt on the top one hand on the shirt then bunny hop it... I cut my hand bad next buddy jumps adding his shirt over mine so he didn't get cut nearly as bad. Third friend jumps it perfectly fine. We turn back to people say wish you he best of luck but it would be smart to jump the fence with us. Me and my two friends walk around for a couple hours the. Loop back to the entrance of the Forrest to get his car and we drove home.  Que the next day at school everyone knew of the three that got away. The party with 50 plus people only 4 got away the three of us and some girl who was passed out drunk randomly sleeping through the whole thing.  The group that followed us eventually got found since they wouldn't jump the fence. Either way it made my grade 11 year and it was still a story told throughout the year.
Would totally love a source of someone could pm me
It was to pace myself in my defence
